evidence.ACL: Grade 2 injury of anterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: linear signal intensity in anterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.

evidence.Fracture: Split fractures at tibial plateau with depression of the lateral articular surface
